purpose: Multiply useful exact 3D stickers into bounded reusable variant families without duplicating source assets: explicit variants or deterministic Cartesian products of declared source parameters and scale become ordinary immutable v1 wrapper stickers in one atomic registry commit.

properties.database: local sticker SQLite registry path; relative paths resolve from the UC root and must stay in creations/.axm-build or outside the machine body
properties.plan: axm.sticker-multiplication/v0.1 exact source pin plus either explicit variants or a bounded parameter/scale matrix

contains: bounded deterministic variant ids and digests

relationships: uses UC's embedded sticker registry and assembly core so external Sticker Fabric remains optional
turns one useful exact source sticker into a controlled family of reusable parameter/scale variants
shares source assets by digest rather than copying GLB or editable-source bytes into every variant

implementation.source: src/axm_uc/sticker_multiplier.py via src/axm_uc/__init__.py registration and src/axm_uc/sticker_create.py JSON authoring path

limitations: matrix axes are declared sticker parameters and one optional scale axis; no random mutation is inferred
wrapper multiplication does not prove visual distinctness, usefulness, geometric fit, aesthetics or target-engine acceptance
a multiplied wrapper retains the source sticker dependency rather than baking duplicate source assets

truth.basis: Exact source pins and declared variant axes are validated before definitions are produced; no undeclared parameter mutation is guessed.

agency.basis: The caller chooses source, explicit variants or matrix axes, authorship/license, naming and whether preview becomes an atomic save.

continuity.basis: Every wrapper pins its exact source and records the canonical multiplication plan in provenance while shared source assets remain content-addressed.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The full bounded batch is expanded and validated before one transaction; invalid values or immutable-version conflicts cannot justify silent partial growth.
